mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with implementing Generative Engine Optimization for local agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of implementing Generative Engine Optimization for local marketing agencies varies widely based on the scope of services, the number of locations, and the complexity of content generation required. Pricing models can include monthly retainers, project-based fees, or performance-based agreements. Factors influencing cost include the depth of AI integration, the volume of content produced, and the level of strategic oversight. Agencies should inquire about detailed proposals that outline specific deliverables and expected outcomes.
